macro_view.summary: The macro backdrop is hawkish. Fed minutes show almost all participants see further hikes as likely appropriate, and markets price a 25bp hike in December (W4). CPI is running at 4.1% YoY and the 10-year yield is 5.1% (PKG). DIA fell 4.3% over the week (PKG). On 18 Nov the Dow dropped about 561 points, with UNH, CVX and CAT the main drags (W3). On 19 Nov, futures jumped after Anthropic's larger-than-expected IPO revived the AI trade: Nasdaq-100 futures +2%, Dow futures +0.6% (W2). Some of that gain will already be in the opening price. For the holiday-shortened week, I expect oversold AI and megacap tech to recover relative to the group. I expect defensive staples that have outperformed, energy (oil softening, W11) and managed care (regulatory pressure, W5) to lag.

picks_rationale: All four picks are AI-linked tech names that were heavily sold off and should recover as Anthropic's successful IPO revives the AI trade (W2). NVDA (-30% in a month, 16x P/E) sold off despite strong results (W1,W7). GOOGL is the cheapest megacap at 14.75x after a 17% slide (W8). CRM's 12.7% weekly drop was tied to repositioning before the IPO (W10). MSFT is a lower-volatility AI exposure. The main risks are a hawkish Fed and 5.1% 10-year yields (W4), and that some of the rebound is already priced in at the open.
